about: raytrace's application mutants (corpus wave HP3): edits of the example that its laws and cases judge, and edits that only TestRaytraceAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (the seeded property against the hand Go control) sees.

mutants.name: raytrace-tree-tie-last-wins
mutants.from:
let d = Intersect(t.Shapes[i], r, lo, best)
					if d != Miss && (d < best || i < shape) {
mutants.to:
let d = Intersect(t.Shapes[i], r, lo, best)
					if d != Miss && (d < best || i > shape) {
mutants.rule: Of equally near shapes, a ray meets the first: the tree agrees with testing every shape in order.

mutants.name: raytrace-sphere-far-root-dropped
mutants.rule: A ray that starts inside a sphere (through glass) meets its far side.

mutants.name: raytrace-stream-per-tile
mutants.from: func(t Tile) []uint8 { RenderTile(sc, t, w, h, spp, seed) }
mutants.to: func(t Tile) []uint8 { RenderTile(sc, t, w, h, spp, seed+uint64(t.X0)) }
mutants.rule: A pixel's samples do not depend on the tile that renders it.

mutants.name: raytrace-sky-goes-negative
mutants.rule: No light is below zero: the sky blends white and blue.

mutants.name: raytrace-glass-ratio-inverted
mutants.rule: Light entering glass bends by 1/index, leaving it by index.

mutants.name: raytrace-metal-never-absorbs
mutants.rule: A blurred reflection that points into the surface is absorbed.

mutants.name: raytrace-one-bounce-too-many
mutants.rule: A path meets at most MaxBounces surfaces.

mutants.name: raytrace-no-gamma
mutants.rule: A channel's byte is the square root of its light (gamma 2).

mutants.name: raytrace-blue-from-green
mutants.rule: A tile's pixels land in the image channel by channel.

mutants.name: raytrace-tile-drops-last-column
mutants.rule: The tiles cover every pixel once.
